title: 第21章 我会还第22章 成为内门
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
叶霄靠着墙坐着，呼吸压得极低，直到确认屋里两人，都睡得安稳。
他才睁开眼，起身到后院，从怀里摸出那十只瓷瓶。
瓷瓶在月色中泛着冷光。
它们不只是药，也是让叶霄得以恢复的燃料。
他没有挑，也没有分，拔塞，仰头。
药入口，干脆利落。
药入腹后，没有热流，没有冲击，却能清晰感受到，体内那股空恢复了不少。
下一刻，他又拔塞，仰头。
第二瓶药入腹。
依旧没有汹涌的热流，也没有暴烈的冲击，只是体内那块被撕开的空，明显又被填实了一截。
他继续吞下去，像往将熄的火堆里不断添柴。
他没有停。
第三瓶。
……
第九瓶。
每一瓶吞下，感觉都一模一样。
没有差别。
没有药效之分，没有所谓对症。
只是直接地，变成了他真正需要的燃料。

直到第十瓶药入腹。
叶霄静静站着，没有立刻动作。
一息。
两息。
三息。
胸口深处，那种始终悬着、仿佛被掏空了一块的感觉，终于彻底消失。
那股空，真的没了。
“果然。”叶霄缓缓吐出一口气，确认了心中猜想。
药性、药效、药的种类，全都无所谓。
只要药力足够，命格里【一证永证】缺少的燃料，就能获得补充。
简单、粗暴，却绝对有效。
就是这药……实在太贵。
既然已经恢复，他没有浪费时间，立刻离开家中。
……
北炉的火，还亮着。
夜色里，炉口翻涌的暗红伏在那里，呼吸沉重而缓慢。
叶霄踏进炉区时，几名老工下意识抬头。
“这小子上次都连站都站不稳了，我还以为要歇大半月，甚至可能死外面了……这才没过三天，又回来了？”有老工脸上满是困惑：“而且他的模样，怎么那么精神？”
content_en:
;;
Ye Xiao sat against the wall, breathing very low until he confirmed that both people in the room were sleeping peacefully.
He just opened his eyes, got up, went to the backyard, and took out the ten porcelain bottles from his arms.
The porcelain bottle glowed coldly in the moonlight.
They are not just medicine, they are also the fuel that allows Ye Xiao to recover.
He didn't pick or divide, he pulled out the plug and raised his head.
The medicine enters the mouth neatly.
After the medicine enters the abdomen, there is no heat flow or shock, but one can clearly feel that the emptiness in the body has recovered a lot.
The next moment, he pulled out the plug again and raised his head.
The second bottle of medicine went into my stomach.
There was still no raging heat or violent impact, but the torn void in his body had obviously been filled up again.
He continued to swallow, like adding fuel to a dying fire.
He didn't stop.
The third bottle.
…
The ninth bottle.
Every bottle you swallow feels exactly the same.
There is no difference.
There is no distinction between medicine and efficacy, and there is no so-called symptomatic treatment.
Just directly, it became the fuel he really needed.
Until the tenth bottle of medicine entered my stomach.
Ye Xiao stood quietly and did not move immediately.
One breath.
Two breaths.
Three breaths.
Deep in the chest, the feeling that had always been hanging there, as if a piece of it had been hollowed out, finally disappeared completely.
That emptiness is really gone.
"Sure enough." Ye Xiao slowly exhaled, confirming his suspicion.
The properties, effects, and types of medicines don’t matter.
As long as the potency of the medicine is sufficient, the fuel that is lacking in the [One Certificate and Forever Certificate] in the life grid can be replenished.
Simple, crude, but absolutely effective.
It's just that this medicine... is too expensive.
Now that he had recovered, he wasted no time and left home immediately.
…
The fire in the north furnace is still on.
In the night, the dark red billowing at the furnace mouth lay there, breathing heavy and slow.
When Ye Xiao stepped into the furnace area, several old workers subconsciously raised their heads.
"This kid couldn't even stand steady last time. I thought he was going to rest for half a month, and he might even die outside... It's only been three days, and he's back again?" An old worker's face was full of confusion: "And why does he look so energetic?"
